summary: The native desktop getDisplayMedia path now checks whether the selected capture source actually starts. A CS_FAILED result removes the unpublished video/audio tracks and stream, stops loopback capture, and returns an actionable platform error instead of allowing a dead screen track to be published. Flutter now prefers the platform error message over the PlatformException wrapper.

checks.name: Native desktop capturer start failure cleanup
checks.observation: The capturer Start() result is checked. On CS_FAILED, the implementation erases the video track, loopback track, and local stream; stops and resets loopback capture; and returns a Capture Failed platform error.

checks.name: Flutter error detail regression test
checks.observation: The test verifies PlatformException.message is surfaced as the screen-share failure detail.
